title: P1 highly available web store
reference: Singapore region; DNS resolving to ESA or CDN; ALB across two zones; ECS with Auto Scaling (or ACK or SAE) across zones; Tair for sessions and cache; PolarDB or RDS high availability across zones; OSS for images served through the edge; WAF as a badge on the ALB or ESA is a plus; SLS and CloudMonitor outside the VPC.

turns.ask: We run an online store in Southeast Asia with about 30,000 daily users and big sales peaks. Design a highly available web architecture.

title: P2 microservices on Kubernetes
reference: ACK (or ACS) across zones; MSE (Nacos) for service discovery and configuration; cloud-native API Gateway or ALB as the entry point; RocketMQ or Kafka between services; Tair; PolarDB or RDS; ACR for images; ARMS or Prometheus and SLS for observability.

turns.ask: We're moving 20 Java microservices to Kubernetes. We need service discovery and configuration, one API entry point, async messaging between services, a cache and a relational database.

title: P3 serverless REST API
reference: Cloud-native API Gateway in front of Function Compute; Tablestore or a serverless RDS or PolarDB; OSS for files; EventBridge or SMQ for asynchronous work; SLS for logs; no servers to manage.

turns.ask: Build a serverless REST API for a mobile app with very spiky traffic. We want to pay only for what we use.

title: P4 RAG assistant on internal documents
reference: An app on Function Compute, SAE or ACK calling Model Studio (Qwen), optionally through AI Gateway; embeddings and vector search in Milvus or OpenSearch; documents in OSS; optional AI Guardrails; never the Model Studio knowledge base, which is closed to new international accounts.

turns.ask: We want an internal assistant that answers employees' questions from our policy documents and wiki, using Qwen models.

title: P5 data platform with CDC, batch and BI
reference: DTS (or Flink CDC) from the MySQL database; Hologres for real-time and MaxCompute for batch analytics; DataWorks for orchestration and governance; Quick BI dashboards; an OSS and DLF lakehouse is optional.

turns.ask: Build a data platform: replicate our MySQL order database in real time, run nightly batch analytics, and give business users dashboards.

title: P6 IoT telemetry streaming
reference: IoT Platform or MQTT for ingest; Kafka or DataHub as the buffer; Flink for real-time anomaly detection; Lindorm, Hologres or Tablestore for time series; DataV or Grafana for live dashboards; alerts through SLS, CloudMonitor or SMS.

turns.ask: We collect telemetry from 100,000 IoT devices every few seconds and need real-time anomaly alerts and a live dashboard.

title: P7 hybrid connectivity and migration
reference: The on-premises data center linked by Express Connect (VPN Gateway as a backup) to a VPC, optionally through CEN or Transit Router; SMC for VM migration; PrivateZone for hybrid DNS; Cloud Backup; ECS targets in the VPC.

turns.ask: Connect our on-premises data center in Singapore to Alibaba Cloud over a private link, and migrate our VMs to the cloud step by step.

title: P8 global multi-region SaaS
reference: Two or three regional stacks (for example Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia) with ALB and compute; GTM, Global Accelerator or ESA for global routing and failover; PolarDB global database or DTS for data sync; CEN between regions; OSS cross-region replication.

turns.ask: Our SaaS serves users in Asia, Europe and the US. We need low latency everywhere and automatic failover between regions.

title: P9 live streaming and VOD
reference: ApsaraVideo Live for ingest and transcoding, VOD for recordings, MPS for processing, OSS for storage and CDN or ESA for delivery; RTS for low latency; an app backend on ECS or ACK.

turns.ask: We're launching a live-streaming and video-on-demand platform for e-sports fans.

title: P10 landing zone and security baseline
reference: Resource Management (Resource Directory) with Governance Center for the landing zone; CloudSSO and RAM; ActionTrail and Cloud Config feeding SLS; Security Center; Cloud Firewall; KMS; Bastionhost; WAF and Anti-DDoS for internet-facing apps.

turns.ask: Set up a secure multi-account landing zone with a security baseline: central identity, audit logging, threat detection and network firewalls.

title: P11 team AI coding (product need)
reference: Qoder Teams (or Qoder Enterprise for governance and audit logs) as the primary answer; optional Model Studio or Token Plan for model access; QwenWork for non-developers; never Lingma or Qoder CN for international users.

turns.ask: Our 25 developers want an agentic AI coding assistant with SSO and admin controls.

title: P12 e-commerce security
reference: ESA or Anti-DDoS Proxy at the edge for DDoS; WAF 3.0 as a badge on the ALB or ESA with bot management; Captcha and Fraud Detection at sign-up and login; Security Center; SLS for security logs.

turns.ask: Our e-commerce site suffers from bot sign-ups, credential stuffing and occasional DDoS attacks. Protect it.
